definitions.explanation: A person who paints or draws pictures, especially as a profession. A casual, everyday word compared with {画家|がか}.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころから{絵描|えか}きになりたかった。
examples.english: I wanted to be a painter ever since I was a child.

examples.japanese: {売|う}れない{絵描|えか}きとして{長|なが}い{間|あいだ}{苦労|くろう}したそうだ。
examples.english: Apparently he struggled for a long time as a painter who couldn't sell his work.

notes:
Formed from {絵|え} (picture) + {描|か}き (drawing, from {描|か}く). A plain, slightly informal word for a painter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵描|えか}きになる: to become a painter
- {売|う}れない{絵描|えか}き: a struggling / unsuccessful painter
- {絵描|えか}き{歌|うた}: a drawing song (a children's song that guides drawing a picture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {画家|がか}: painter — more formal and dignified, used for established artists
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}: artist — broader, covers all the arts
